Part numberNP-IPG-100
Statusapproved
BuildsBLD-0001, BLD-0002

Description

The implanted unit: hermetic titanium can holding the battery, the microcontroller running the closed-loop algorithm (DES-0001) and the pulse-generator ASIC (CMP-0002), with ports for the stimulation and sense leads.
